limitations: This is a snapshot of currently available API records, not proof of the absence of deleted, expired, or never-triggered runs.
Records report each run's current/final attempt; this does not enumerate every historical rerun attempt.

pipeline.rate_definition: 50 successful pipeline runs / 52 completed pipeline runs in this bounded API history.
rate_is_not: proof that all expected runs triggered

pages.cancellation_handling: Pages cancellations are kept separate from pipeline failures. A cancellation is not counted as a failed pipeline or proof of downtime.

supersession_examples.interpretation: A newer data-commit Pages run started during the older deployment and subsequently succeeded; supersession is inferred from ordering and commit lineage, while logs directly establish cancellation only.
